title_en: By bus: z with the instrumental
card_en: Z means with or by and takes the instrumental: masculine and neuter -om (z avtobusom), or -em after c, č, š, ž, j (s čajem); feminine mostly -o. Before k, p, t and similar sounds it is s: s kartico.

quick_check.explain_en: After z, vlak takes the instrumental: z vlakom.

helper_de: Like German mit: z avtobusom is mit dem Bus, and the ending of the noun changes.
helper_en: English says by bus and by car; Slovenian uses the word for with: z avtobusom, z avtom.
